Founded in 2021, GreenAnt has been focusing on developing tools for climate resilience and has operated in Thailand and Vietnam. In 2023, we merged with SarVision, a Wageningen University’s data analysis spin-off, to become a leader in analyzing radar satellite data to provide climate adaptation tools and services.
 
We have developed unique intellectual property for analyzing radar data. Desidera, our flagship product, offers data-backed services to help manage climate risks. This includes predicting harvest failures, assessing flood risks, and estimating damages promptly after such events. Our approach combines artificial intelligence with extensive satellite data, offering a powerful tool for insurers, farmers, and traders to collaboratively tackle climate risks.
 
Using our AI-powered SaaS platform, Desidera, users have the flexibility to choose from a variety of subscription packages to obtain services such as EUDR certifications, comprehensive floods and harvest insurance policy bundles, and a variety of data-driven tools for evaluating and managing climate risks.
 
By making satellite data analysis accessible to the sectors most exposed to climate risk, we aim to promote sustainability and climate stewardship, across agriculture, real estate, and insurance.

Alpine Data Ventures GmbH (ADV) is an independent data and artificial intelligence consultancy based in Munich, Germany. Founded in 2025 by four partners with senior backgrounds in corporate data leadership, data engineering, business intelligence and AI product development, ADV supports organisations in building the data foundations, architectures and AI capabilities required to operate in regulated and mission-critical environments.
The company covers the full data lifecycle across three practice areas. Data Strategy and Governance includes data strategy development, governance frameworks, data catalogues, master data management, maturity assessments and organisational enablement. Data Engineering and Architecture includes data warehouses, data lakes, data mesh implementations, ETL and pipeline development, enterprise architecture management and sovereign, European hosted data platforms. AI and Data Science includes machine learning, computer vision for automated visual inspection and object detection, anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, forecasting and demand planning, digital twin and simulation, and retrieval augmented generation for technical documentation and knowledge access.
Information security and data protection form a cross-cutting fourth competence. ADV provides external Data Protection Officer mandates under GDPR, external Information Security Officer mandates, ISMS implementation aligned to ISO 27001, NIS2 compliance assessments, and identity and access management concepts. Members of the management team hold TÜV certification as Data Protection Officer and as IT Security Officer.
ADV operates on a principle of accountability the company describes as Skin in the Game: it stands behind what it recommends and implements it where required. Engagements are delivered by senior consultants working directly with the client, from short assessments through to multi-year mandates.
Clients include industrial and manufacturing companies as well as public sector bodies at federal, state and municipal level in Germany. Working languages are German and English.

OMEGA Space Technology GmbH is a German space-tech start-up developing satellite-based crop analytics for the European agricultural insurance market. The company was incorporated on 10 February 2026 in Munich, Germany (share capital €25,000) and operates from Munich/Oberpfaffenhofen, at the heart of Europe's largest space cluster. OMEGA currently has three full-time founders; a Customer Success & Sales manager and a Junior Developer are planned for mid-2027.
OMEGA's mission is to close the structural data gap that prevents Multi-Peril Crop Insurance (MPCI) in Europe. While the US MPCI market ($17.3B in premiums) is built on decades of field-level yield and loss history, no equivalent dataset exists in Europe. OMEGA reconstructs and builds this field-level data layer by fusing multiple Earth observation sources — Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 optical, Landsat, EnMAP hyperspectral, weather, soil and ground-truth data — through a combination of physics-based, auditable algorithms and selectively deployed machine learning. This architecture is designed for the regulatory requirements of the insurance sector (BaFin auditability, EU AI Act explainability).
The company's first commercial capability — deterministic SAR-based storm damage detection (Patent #1, filed with WIPANO funding) — is in production and has been validated against historical insurer claims data with very high agreement to on-site loss assessments. Building on this foundation, OMEGA is developing SecureEye, a preventive crop monitoring service distributed to farmers through their insurers, together with a portfolio-level risk and underwriting dashboard for insurance customers.
Customer engagement includes Vereinigte Hagel (Germany's largest crop insurer, >5M ha; technology validated against 2025 claims cases), Allianz Agrar (Letter of Intent; software validated against historical claims; evaluation under the Allianz Agrar "Vision 2030" strategy), Versicherungskammer Bayern (specialty-crop discussions) and Munich Re (structural validation of the field-level data gap; invitation to present at Munich Re's 2026 crop insurance customer event). In the precision-farming vertical, OMEGA operates commercial pilots with Dina Farms, Egypt (1,000 feddan; 20% demonstrated water savings) and Lotus, Egypt (700 ha), and validates its platform in Southern Europe through the EIT Food Test Farms Programme. The platform runs on Google Cloud infrastructure ($75,000 in secured credits).
The founding team combines the disciplines required for the project. Sherif Elsayed (CEO) and Marcel Winzen (CFO/COO) each bring 9 years of satellite engineering experience at Airbus Defence & Space, covering EO payload characterisation and calibration for NASA/ESA/JAXA missions, satellite assembly, integration and test, and ESA/EU programme management; they previously co-founded Nabta Playa e.V., a non-profit EO research institute for food security applications. Ahmed Daker (AI/ML Lead, formerly SAS and Omdena) owns the technical stack end-to-end, from Sentinel data ingestion to ML models and cloud-native deployment.
OMEGA's recognition and funding track record includes winning the ESA BA Challenge of the INNOspace Masters 2026, acceptance into the EIT Food Accelerator Network (2026 cohort), participation in the final selection round of ESA BIC Bavaria, and WIPANO patent funding. The company's long-term roadmap includes KingTut, a planned agri-optimised multispectral satellite constellation (from 2029), which is financed separately and is not part of this proposal.

QRBIT is a private capital company, founded by researchers from the Institute of Communication and Computer Systems (ICCS) of the National Technical University of Athens (NTUA). The company was co-founded by Dr. Ioannis (Giannis) Giannoulis, Dr. Aristeidis (Aris) Stathis, and Mr. Argyrios (Argiris) Ntanos, leveraging a strong foundation of research in optical communications and quantum cryptography developed within the Photonic Communications Research Laboratory (PCRL) at ICCS/NTUA.
Dr. Giannoulis serves as the company’s administrator, while Dr. Stathis and Mr. Ntanos are also shareholders. Small equity shares in QRBIT are held by prominent faculty members of the School of Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE) at NTUA, including Prof. Iraklis Avramopoulos (Head of PCRL), Prof. Athanasios Panagopoulos, and Asst. Prof. Dimitrios Apostolopoulos, who provide strategic guidance and contribute to the company’s R&D and consulting activities.
The QRBIT team is a multi-disciplinary group of quantum engineers—comprising two electrical engineers and a physicist—combining deep expertise in physics, optical engineering, and electrical engineering to advance laser and quantum communication technologies for terrestrial free-space and satellite links. Their work spans both theoretical and experimental domains, including the formulation and simulation of quantum communication protocols and the practical deployment, testing, and integration of QKD (Quantum Key Distribution) systems in both fiber and free-space networks.
QRBIT is actively developing state-of-the-art quantum and optical technology prototypes, such as QKD sub-systems, optical telescope assemblies, and specialized software tools (e.g., QuantLink, QBER modeling tools for noisy channels). The team also conducts experimental research using both portable and large astronomical telescopes, integrating custom optical systems to enable quantum and advanced optical applications.

description:
Melsa Biotech (Toggam Enterprises Limited) is an Irish advanced-materials company producing high-purity eumelanin, a bio-derived functional biopolymer, from circular natural-origin biomass using a proprietary multi-stage extraction process.
 Eumelanin combines broadband ultraviolet, visible and near-infrared absorption, photothermal energy dissipation, free-radical scavenging, thermal stability and potential charge-dissipative behaviour in a single lightweight, sustainable material. These properties make it a candidate active for multifunctional protective coatings addressing UV shielding, thermal management, oxidative protection and partial radiation mitigation. Our material has been independently validated: to 99% purity confirmed by third-party assay, and a six-technique characterisation study by the University of Galway (TGA, 13C NMR, TEM, AFM, SAXS, XPS) confirming eumelanin structure and demonstrating high thermal stability, with approximately 35 to 40% mass retention at 900 degrees Celsius.

Space and aerospace relevance: bio-derived multifunctional coatings for spacecraft and satellite materials (thermal, UV and radiation protection of lightweight polymers, composites and surfaces), aligned with sustainable and EU-sovereign advanced-material supply. Adjacent capabilities span defence, semiconductor, electronics and high-performance industrial coatings.
Core competencies: bio-based advanced materials, functional biopolymers and pigments, protective and functional coatings, materials characterisation, and specialty high-value material supply. Based in Ireland with in-house production and analytical capability, supported by academic and industry partnerships.
